nifty200.label: Nifty 200 validated model
nifty200.method: Value, Quality, Momentum, Low Volatility factor sleeves with regime weights and constrained portfolio construction.

nifty500.label: Nifty 500 AI candidates
nifty500.method: Real monthly NSE prices. Weighted ensemble: 12m momentum 35%, 6m momentum 25%, 3m momentum 15%, low volatility 15%, drawdown control 10%. Momentum is Bayesian-shrunk for shorter histories.
nifty500.validationNote: This is a Nifty 500 stock-ranking recommendation layer. It is not yet the fully backtested portfolio model until point-in-time Nifty 500 membership and fundamentals are collected.
